answer.rationale: Run a targeted, guarded activation-messaging test for price-sensitive SMB accounts, emphasizing time-to-value and realized product value. In-product messaging improved week-one engagement, activation, and retention, while shortened onboarding also improved retention. Avoid broad promotional pricing: although it can lift SMB acquisition and revenue, it materially harmed 30-day retention and is unsuitable for the sustainable-revenue objective. The doubled churn conversations indicate urgency, but do not establish that messaging will offset competitor price cuts, so measure churn, activation, qualified revenue, and retention before scaling.
